verses.text: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!

xrefs.text: The name of the LORD is a strong tower; the righteous run to it and are safe.
Then the Ziphites came to Saul at Gibeah and said, “Is not David hiding on the hill of Hachilah, opposite Jeshimon?”
Help us, O God of our salvation, for the glory of Your name; deliver us and atone for our sins, for the sake of Your name.
Salvation exists in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to men by which we must be saved.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.

verses.text: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.

xrefs.text: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. Listen to my prayer, O God, and do not ignore my plea.
For the choirmaster, to be accompanied by flutes. A Psalm of David. Give ear to my words, O LORD; consider my groaning.

verses.text: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life— men with no regard for God. Selah

xrefs.text: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.
For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
They will do these things because they have not known the Father or Me.
Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
I have set the LORD always before me. Because He is at my right hand, I will not be shaken.

verses.text: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.

xrefs.text: So we say with confidence: “The Lord is my helper; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?”
The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Do not fear, for I am with you; do not be afraid, for I am your God. I will strengthen you; I will surely help you; I will uphold you with My righteous right hand.
What then shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.

verses.text: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.

xrefs.text: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
Alexander the coppersmith did great harm to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

verses.text: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.

xrefs.text: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name— for it is good— in the presence of Your saints.
Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
To that place you are to bring your burnt offerings and sacrifices, your tithes and heave offerings, your vow offerings and freewill offerings, as well as the firstborn of your herds and flocks.

verses.text: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.

xrefs.text: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
And the Lord will rescue me from every evil action and bring me safely into His heavenly kingdom. To Him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
